name: Image Megapixel Calculator
description: Calculate megapixels, total pixels and aspect ratio from image dimensions.
search_intent: Find how many megapixels an image resolution contains.
calculation: Total pixels = width × height. Megapixels = total pixels / 1,000,000. Simplify the aspect ratio using the greatest common divisor when width and height are positive.
limitations: Megapixel count measures pixel quantity, not overall image quality.
Lens, sensor, compression and processing also affect image quality.
